_doc: Part 188 class map. vis: VocalImitationSet category path (category_d2..d5 joined by ' / ', as in meta/vocal_imitations.txt at commit b77114c43c52f5faa7d0bb69b22e1ebca0632201). esc: ESC-50 category names. group: the animal the fold split works on. phrase: used in the model's own verdict prompts 'the sound of {phrase}' and 'a person imitating the sound of {phrase}'. vocal: whether the sound is made by the animal's voice (exploratory split only). Cattle / Cowbell is excluded: a cowbell is not an animal sound.
